function.name: lexical_search
function.description: Search Trivae messages with exact lexical matching and a bounded local context window. Normally call this first for repository names, URLs, code, error messages, nicknames, exact phrases, or other precise terms. For a paraphrase or conceptual description without a precise term, normally call semantic_search first instead. Do not call both just to hedge; do not repeat this tool with the same or nearly identical arguments after no hits, and do not use translation, synonym, punctuation, or near-duplicate queries as multi-query expansion. Use the other tool only when the first result is weak or insufficient. When filtering by a person, sender_user_ids must contain the canonical user_id from find_members, never a QQ number/UIN, nickname, group card, or display name. keyword must be exactly one non-empty string. Omit optional filters, or use null; do not send empty arrays. limit must be a positive integer within the current trusted result limit. For a broad inventory or resource-list question, set limit to the current trusted maximum, not a smaller convenience value. For a resource inventory, a non-empty github.com result is sufficient for URL-bearing recall: do not call get_recent_messages or execute_sql to enumerate or recount the same resources. A generic learning-material inventory may add one semantic_search for non-URL materials, but must not prefetch a broad recent window. context_before and context_after must be non-negative integers. Use the short source_id handle from the current Tool Result for each citation; do not copy full provenance. The current lexical result limit is 100. function.name: get_recent_messages
function.description: Read the most recent messages inside a time range for temporal browsing: use it as the first call when the candidate set is determined mainly by time and the user asks for an overview, summary, topic discovery, or what people talked about recently (for example '最近两天聊了什么', '昨天发生了什么'). For a repository, GitHub-link, Skill, or URL-bearing resource inventory, even when it says '最近', use lexical_search with keyword 'github.com' as the first retrieval call instead of prefetching this broad recent window. For a generic learning-material inventory, use lexical_search for links and semantic_search for non-URL materials; do not use this tool merely to broaden an inventory after retrieval. Do NOT guess topics and search them with lexical_search or semantic_search for this kind of question; read the real recent window first, then analyze and cite. Calling it without any time argument defaults to the most recent 2 days anchored at archive_latest (never machine current time). The tool returns the latest `limit` canonical messages of the resolved window in natural chronological reading order, plus returned/total counts and truncated. Zero results is a normal outcome when the window truly has no messages. Prefer limit at or near the schema maximum for broad recent-activity questions so a two-day overview is not needlessly partial. final_answer:
AI 编程工具与模型订阅是这段窗口里最突出的话题。彩笔在「一群开心快乐的小奶龙」判断厂商涨价是为了赶走算力消耗大的用户、把算力省给 coding 场景（“他们涨价目的就是为了赶走用户”“然后对coding 场景做优化”“其他像算命/聊天这种希望都赶走”“把算力省出来”）；Aqua 在星河社感叹 20 刀档位的 Claude 已经和写代码绝缘，浅仪式担心那个 50% 额度会被取消，并吐槽 Anthropic。

围绕具体工具的使用体验也有不少讨论：Aqua 说自己用 OpenAI 的插件接入 Codex 写代码，并给出了仓库链接 https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc ；Blue 则表示自己现在只用 pi，吐槽 opencode 有时会内存溢出（“一个hello 一百兆”“我64g的内存都不够他吃的”），后来还提到考虑是否用 superpower、目前只装了 websearch、把 AI 运行在 podman 里控制访问权限；另有群友称“opencode就差全天下打广告找人用了”，以及有人表示可以用手机微信远程 Codex。

求职与职业方向也被提及：楚玉衡和 SakuraiCora 在贺兰群刷“我一定要加入腾讯”，𝙍𝙪𝙞𝙔𝙞𝙚𝙧 在识海群问“现在真实批约面节奏啥样的”。这些更像零散的目标表达和提问，尚未形成长讨论。

日常闲聊、玩梗与角色扮演同样占了不小比重：贺兰群里有“玩了快半个月了”“我和 hl 同居的”“hl 早被我凿成泡芙了”这类玩笑互动（被聊斋仙吐槽“早知道就不在睡前看一眼你群聊天记录了”“我的眼睛”）；星河社有一批人用 [[喵]]、[[趴]] 之类的猫咪表情梗互动，还有围绕“锤Dario狗头”的接龙。

其他零散内容还出现：find 在 cs61abc 分享作品集网站 https://www.wallofportfolios.in/?company=All 并评论“这个网站设计师大多都是印度的”；以及关于隐私/账号同步（“那也不应该呀，顶多同步密码那些”）、浏览器权限导致异常等简短技术疑问。

重要覆盖说明：本次只取到了最近 30 天窗口中的最新 100 条消息，窗口本身有约 7.3 万条消息且被截断，因此以上总结反映的是窗口末端（最新一批）的讨论面貌，不代表整个 30 天的主导话题分布。
